total_supply_before.meaning: totalSupply set by the constructor before any deposit

sum_balances_before.meaning: sum of all account balances before any deposit (empty mapping)

first_deposit_assets.meaning: assets deposited by the first depositor

sum_balances_after.meaning: sum of all balances after the first deposit (1,000,000,000)

assumptions: The constructor-set totalSupply of 1,000,000 is not backed by any minted shares, so sum of balances before deposit is 0.
The first depositor is a single account whose deposit is the only balance change considered.
The deposit calculation yields 1,000,000,000 shares credited to the first depositor.

unresolved.description: Report states sum of balances after deposit is 1,000,000,000 and totalSupply is 1,001,000,000 but does not give the exact per-account balance breakdown or the minting step that produced the 1,001,000,000 totalSupply; the conservation relation is bound to the stated aggregate values only.

limitations: Only the post-deposit invariant break (invariant_broken_post) is formalized; the initial invariant break and excess-share dilution are separate impacts not covered here.
The conservation pattern compares aggregate sum of balances against totalSupply at the stated checkpoints; per-account distribution is not modeled.
